response.note: Assumes order_status uses the value 'SUCCESS' for successful orders; September 2026 order-level success rate is computed over all orders created that month.
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS order_success_rate_pct FROM v_orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' LIMIT 50
